data_availability_text: Data availabilityGWAS summary statistics for ALS are available through the IEU Open GWAS project (identifier: ebi-a-GCST005647). Gene expression datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus database (GSE68607, GSE4595, GSE41414, GSE87385). Gut microbiota genetic data are accessible from the Netherlands Microbiome Project, and immune cell genetics from the Sardinian population study. eQTL and pQTL data were sourced from the eQTLGen consortium and deCODE genetics databases. Clinical validation data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. All publicly available datasets can be accessed through their respective repositories.
